stories.title: Facade Error Handling and Fallback Strategy
stories.description: Implement standardized error handling in the EvaluateCare facade, including graceful degradation when clinical trials API, NPI lookup, or travel services fail. Ensure user-safe responses and no raw exceptions propagate to tool_router.

stories.title: Facade Observability and Debug Logging
stories.description: Integrate debug_logger to capture facade inputs, outputs, timing, and error conditions for clinical trials and provider detail flows, ensuring compliance with de-identification rules.

stories.title: Facade Contract Versioning and Response Normalization
stories.description: Define and enforce a stable, versioned response structure for EvaluateCare outputs, normalizing clinical trial and provider detail responses into a consistent schema for downstream LLM and UI consumption.
